items.text: Four of a kind reset: Player with four of a kind may score 7 points or reset all other players' scores to zero; hand ends if reset.
Straight flush 10 points: Some play 10 points for straight flush instead of 8.
Exchange limit 42: Some play that the limit at which you can no longer exchange cards is 42 rather than 46.
Chicago declarer leads: Player who declares Chicago in phase three then leads to the first trick.
Chicago required in three-player: In three-player, a player must have succeeded with at least one Chicago to win at 52 or more; 52 without a Chicago is zeroed.
